description: Coverage floors (PVA-M2.3). Floors only rise; loosening needs an ADR and the owner.
branch_floor_note: combined static + database jobs; ecosystem floor 85 reached by PVA-M4.12 (2026-11-22) with tests, not exclusions; the interim 76 floor is removed
static_branch_floor_note: static job alone (service-gated tests skipped); raised from 76 by PVA-M4.12 after local static branch coverage rose from 78.3% to 84.6%; the margin covers the CI-versus-local difference (about 1.3 points)
